$comment: Approved deltas between Design HTML v4 (docs/prd/day-passv4.html) and the build (Sprint 0003 A5, v2; supersedes the v1.2 list of Sprint 0002 A4). Each entry cites the v4 line, PRD, CR or plan line that approves it. Only a human may add entries; the parity runner exempts exactly what is listed and reports everything else. AD-11…AD-13 are Sprint 0003 placeholders for the orchestrator's D1 (the plan numbered them AD-10…AD-12; AD-10 was already taken by the v1.2 tab-row width delta, kept here). The loop is NOT run this sprint.

deltas.text: We'll email you a one-time code and your receipt
deltas.reason: Transactional email notice under the email field; the prototype hides #identHelp until an error.
deltas.cite: v4 line 492 (`#identHelp` hidden until an error); PRD v3.4 §4.5 Tier 0 (D35); SPRINT-0003 U1 (unchanged from SPRINT-0002 U1)

deltas.reason: Transactional-SMS notice under the mobile field and the unchecked marketing opt-in row; absent from v4 (which has no helper under the mobile field at all after CR-14).
deltas.cite: v4 line 570 (mobile field without any helper — CR-14 removed 'We'll text your pass here on the day.'); CR-09; PRD D32b, D37, §4.5; SPRINT-0003 U22

deltas.reason: Required Mobile field under Your info when the recognised person has no mobile on file (not rendered for the m@m.com twin, so no pixel effect in the loop).
deltas.cite: v4 lines 540-545 (Your info rows: Name / Email / Mobile from the record only); PRD D37; SPRINT-0002 U5 'approved delta'; SPRINT-0003 Q-2 carried

deltas.reason: The Pay Page hosted frame (or TestCardPanel with hooks) replaces the mocked card fields; internals masked, wrapper bounds and neighbouring spacing compared.
deltas.cite: v4 lines 500-519 (`.payfields` card form) / 214-219 (styles); CR-03, CR-04; PRD D44; SPRINT-0002 §Parity loop masks

deltas.reason: Static location label: same text and box, rendered without aria-haspopup / listbox semantics.
deltas.cite: v4 line 297 (`.dt-switcher` with aria-haspopup=listbox); SPRINT-0002 interview decision 'static location label'

deltas.reason: Retry / error affordances (session failure, 503 lookup retry, embed load failure) exist only in error states outside the eleven parity states.
deltas.cite: v4 line 576 (`.dt-alert.danger#formErr` hidden unless an error); SPRINT-0002 U9, U15; SPRINT-0003 U12 delivery variants are AD-13

deltas.reason: Sprint 0001 wallet-retry alert for a failed save and the Sprint 0003 'Resend pass email' action; not reachable in the parity runs (saves and sends succeed).
deltas.cite: v4 lines 594-596 (only the success alert or the not-saved help on done); SPRINT-0002 U17 'approved delta'; SPRINT-0003 U11 'saved-card / not-saved / retry alerts as Sprint 0002'

deltas.reason: The build defaults the date to club-local today, so the prototype's blank-date help string 'Choose the day you'll visit…' is never rendered; the prototype driver sets #day to the same day before capture.
deltas.cite: v4 line 626 (blank-date string "Choose the day you'll visit…" vs validityLabel()); CR §D 'Date selector — confirmed correct'; SPRINT-0003 U6/U7 (date defaults to club-local today)

deltas.reason: Refunds paragraph follows PRD D15/D22 ('Refunds: none online. Any refund is at the club's discretion, in club.') instead of v1.2's 'Full refund any time before the first valid day'.
deltas.cite: v4 line 374 ('Full refund any time before the first valid day of your pass.'); PRD v3.4 D15, D22; SPRINT-0003 §2 'refund paragraph unchanged (PRD D15/D22, AD-09)'; CR-17

deltas.reason: At 375 px the prototype tab row overflows its 375 px container (padding 16 px + four tabs); the build clips the same row with overflow-x auto. Only width is exempt; text, font and colours are compared.
deltas.cite: v4 lines 72 and 75 (`.dt-tabs` padding 0 48px; ≤640px padding s4) — no overflow rule in v4 either; SPRINT-0002 C8a; BROWSER-QA P1-6; SPRINT-0003 regression 'no horizontal overflow at 320–440 px with three cards'

deltas.reason: Single-offer clubs (Riverside 90030) render one centred card inside `.offers.single`; v4 has no single-offer design (three cards only). Only the grid template / justification of `.offers` is exempt; the card itself is compared. Parity club 90033 renders three cards, so this delta has no pixel effect in the loop.
deltas.cite: SPRINT-0003 U3 'approved delta AD-10 — v4 has no single-offer design' (renumbered AD-11 here); CR-10 'Riverside stays single-offer'; Change_Requests_2026-09-15 §A CR-10 notes
deltas.status: approved-by-plan (SPRINT-0003 §Use Cases U3/U11/U12); DESIGN review pending (PC-1)

deltas.reason: 'View your pass' link under the pass sentence and as a Receipt row, plus the 'Resend pass email' secondary action; v4's done page (lines 582-600) has neither (CR-13 comes from D41 / Design v2 alignment rows 8-9, not from v4).
deltas.cite: SPRINT-0003 U11, U12, §6 'Done page and receipt'; CR-13; PRD v3.4 D41, FR-P15, UC J1 step 6; Change_Requests_2026-09-15 §A CR-13
deltas.status: approved-by-plan (SPRINT-0003 §Use Cases U3/U11/U12); DESIGN review pending (PC-1)

deltas.reason: Truthful delivery variants of the v4 sentence (line 590): `pending` → 'We're sending your pass and door QR code to {masked}. You can view your pass here.'; `failed` → 'We couldn't email your pass and door QR code to {masked}. You can view your pass here, or say your name at the front desk.'; `not-attempted` → desk sentence only. The `sent` text is v4 verbatim and is compared, not exempt.
deltas.cite: SPRINT-0003 U12 '(approved deltas)', §6 sentence table; CR-12; Change_Requests_2026-09-15 §D
deltas.status: approved-by-plan (SPRINT-0003 §Use Cases U3/U11/U12); DESIGN review pending (PC-1)
